definitions: Unable to stop oneself from doing something, often something one knows is not ideal or intended.
To have an irresistible urge or compulsion to do something.
examples: I know I shouldn't eat another cookie, but I can't help myself.
Every time I see a cute puppy, I can't help myself; I have to pet it.
She tried to stay quiet, but she just couldn't help herself and blurted out the answer.
